summary: Iteration 25 — Admin User Control + Password Reset widgets. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass against the live preview URL (search permissions, suspend/unsuspend incl. auto-resolve of elapsed suspensions, login while suspended returns the spec-mandated detail, mute single-types + 'all'→7-type fan-out, mute clear, delete username-confirmation guard, founder-only password reset with bcrypt rehash + session-invalidation via password_changed_at>iat, weak-password rejection, protected-account guards, audit_log entries with no plaintext password, regression on realm-pulse/communities/hashtags/support summary). Frontend: founder sees both widgets at /profile/support, non-admin (tfone) sees neither, search→suspend→mute→delete-gate UI flows all work (verified via Playwright with the documented data-testids). One frontend observation: in a single chained UI session the Unsuspend / Clear-mutes click did not refresh the row (the row still showed SUSPENDED + the mute chip after the click) — backend equivalents work via curl/pytest, so this looks like a row-state-refresh issue in AdminUserControlWidget after consecutive state-mutating clicks rather than an API bug.

minor.issue: Passwords <8 chars return Pydantic 422 (string_too_short) instead of the spec-required 400 with the custom validator string. The custom _validate_password_strength('Password must be at least 8 chars') never runs because Field(min_length=8) short-circuits. To match the spec verbatim, drop min_length=8 from the Pydantic Field and rely solely on _validate_password_strength.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking admin-user-unsuspend-btn-<id> (and similarly admin-user-clear-mutes-<id>) in the same session that just suspended/muted the row, the inline row state (the SUSPENDED chip / Muted line) does not visibly refresh even though the backend mutation succeeds. A subsequent re-search picks up the fresh state correctly. Likely a stale `user` prop / missing setState after the action API resolves.

In the UI run, clicking admin-pwreset-submit after filling matching valid passwords did not surface admin-pwreset-success within 3.5s, while the identical sequence via curl/pytest returns 200 ok:true. Most likely the row above carried a stale tfone state (SUSPENDED + muted) which forced the founder token's session-invalidation path on the next /api/auth/me poll, but worth verifying the submit handler updates the success flag synchronously off the 200 response.

action_items: (Minor) Drop min_length=8 from PasswordResetPayload.new_password / confirm_password so the custom validator's 400 message ('Password must be at least 8 chars') is what callers see, matching the spec.

(UI) After admin-user-unsuspend-btn / admin-user-clear-mutes resolve, update the local user object passed into the row component (or refetch the single user) so the SUSPENDED chip and mute line clear immediately without requiring a fresh search.

(UI verify) Re-run admin-pwreset-submit on a fresh founder session with a non-suspended target and confirm admin-pwreset-success appears; if not, hook the success state directly to the 200 response handler.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_user_control.py: every endpoint uses _safe_user() projection — password_hash and private notes never leak. Good.
audit_log writes never include payload.new_password / confirm_password — only force_change_on_next_login flag. Verified at DB level.
deps.get_current_user auto-resolves elapsed suspensions before serving the request — verified end-to-end.
core/security.create_access_token now embeds iat — used by Session-invalidated check after password reset.
Protected-account guard (_can_act_on) correctly blocks @stealth-on-self, blocks non-stealth on @support, and permits stealth→support reset_password.

success_rate.frontend: ~83% (5/6 UI flows verified end-to-end; PW-reset success banner not observed in chained run though backend confirms 200 ok)

seed_data_creation: None. Test suite mutates tfone (suspend/mute/password) but restores it via mongo-backed teardown that wipes login_attempts and resets password_hash to bcrypt('pass1234').
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_admin_user_control.py wipes db.login_attempts at module setup AND teardown (suspended-login attempts get registered as failures and trip the brute-force lockout otherwise). It also restores tfone to the canonical pass1234 + clean state in teardown via direct mongo, since the admin reset-password endpoint rejects pass1234 on strength grounds. The Playwright UI run uses localStorage('ourrealm.access') to inject a fresh token (same shortcut as iteration_24).
rca of the issue: The 422-vs-400 mismatch on short passwords is a Pydantic-ordering quirk: Field(min_length=8) runs before the body lands in our route, so _validate_password_strength never sees a short input. Easiest fix: remove min_length from the Field and let the validator own the rule (it already returns the exact message the spec calls for). For the UI row-state quirk: the row inside AdminUserControlWidget renders against a `user` object that probably isn't being replaced after the action's response.user comes back — check the array setter in the parent results list.
